name: teamwork-skill

interface.shortDescription: Retained Claude Code compatibility adapter for development use.
interface.longDescription: This retained Claude Code adapter is for compatibility maintenance and local development. It keeps clear work native and adds focused methods plus an optional low-cost Writer for owner-confirmed Markdown records, without mandatory stage chains or document state gates.
defaultPrompt: Use $teamwork-collaborate to explore this decision with me and recommend a direction.
Use $teamwork-research to investigate this external question across primary sources.
Use $teamwork-debug to diagnose this unknown-cause failure before changing it.
